sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare and Energy dominate leadership with sustained cross-period strength, while Consumer Defensive shows early signs of fading despite an all-green profile.

Market breadth remains narrow with only 3 of 11 sectors holding positive returns across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD). Leadership is concentrated at the top: Healthcare (momentum 0.883) and Energy (momentum 0.850) maintain sustained dominance across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, with Healthcare advancing another spot to rank 3 over the past 5 sessions.

Meanwhile, lower-momentum segments are struggling to gain traction. Communication Services (momentum 0.217) and Utilities (momentum 0.167) anchor the bottom of the table, while Consumer Defensive is beginning to lose short-term ground despite its broader multi-timeframe strength.

## Strength
- **Narrow leadership breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Healthcare (momentum 0.88), Energy (momentum 0.85), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.65).
- **Sustained leaders:** Healthcare and Energy are the sole sectors holding top-3 rank consistency across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Top ranks defended:** Energy holds the #1 YTD spot with an 0.850 momentum score, followed by Technology at rank 2 (momentum 0.633).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Upward movers:** Healthcare gained +1 spot over the last 5 sessions to reach rank 3 (momentum 0.883), while Real Estate ticked up +1 spot to rank 8 despite weak momentum (0.267).
- **Momentum leaders:** Healthcare (0.883), Energy (0.850), Consumer Defensive (0.650), Technology (0.633), and Financial (0.550) lead the market.
- **Persistent laggards:** Utilities (0.167, rank 10), Communication Services (0.217, rank 9), and Real Estate (0.267, rank 8) sit at the bottom of the momentum rankings, joined by Consumer Cyclical pinned at rank 11 (momentum 0.45).

## Divergences
- **Fading momentum in Consumer Defensive:** Consumer Defensive dropped -1 spot over the past 5 sessions to rank 4, signaling an early divergence against its 0.65 momentum score and all-green status.
- **Weak rotation in Communication Services:** Communication Services slipped -1 spot to rank 9, compounding its poor 0.217 momentum reading.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Leadership remains tightly concentrated in travel, healthcare, and energy, while industrials and tech-adjacent groups experience sharp near-term rank deteriorations.

Market breadth shows 28 of 144 groups holding all-green status, anchored by durable leadership across healthcare (Health Information Services, Diagnostics & Research, Medical Distribution) and energy (Oil & Gas Integrated, Oil & Gas E&P). Travel and hospitality continue to show exceptional strength, with REIT - Hotel & Motel leading overall momentum at 0.921 and Lodging surging 17 spots over the past five sessions to reach a 0.882 momentum score. 

Rotations are surfacing beneath the surface. Capital is stepping into beaten-down housing and building plays like Residential Construction and Building Materials despite muted momentum profiles. Conversely, heavy cyclical pockets and tech are fading rapidly, headlined by steep weekly drops in Engineering & Construction (-23 spots) and Internet Content & Information (-18 spots), while Software - Infrastructure flashes an early divergence signal.

## Strength
- **Hospitality & Leisure Surge:** REIT - Hotel & Motel tops the momentum leaderboard at 0.921 (rank 7 YTD), supported by Lodging, which holds an all-green profile with a 0.882 momentum score.
- **Healthcare & Energy Resilience:** Health Information Services (0.883 momentum, rank 17), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.867), Diagnostics & Research (0.860), and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.860) remain sustained performers across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows.
- **Broad Breadth Floor:** 28 of 144 groups maintain positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD frames.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Insurance Brokers led five-session rank improvement (+17 spots to rank 103, 0.63 momentum), tied with Lodging (+17 spots to rank 29), followed by Silver (+14 spots to rank 46, 0.59 momentum) and Biotechnology (+11 spots to rank 43, 0.68 momentum).
- **Severe De-rankings:** Engineering & Construction dropped 23 spots to rank 61 (0.23 momentum), Coking Coal fell 21 spots to rank 119 (0.23 momentum), and Internet Content & Information shed 18 spots to rank 75 (0.46 momentum).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** REIT - Mortgage (0.069 momentum, rank 137 YTD), Solar (0.086 momentum, rank 139 YTD), and Advertising Agencies (0.108 momentum, rank 144 YTD) anchor the bottom of all tracked groups.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Software - Infrastructure (0.63 momentum) slipped 7 rank spots in 5 sessions, alongside Shell Companies (0.71 momentum, -6 spots) and Tobacco (0.64 momentum, -6 spots), signaling near-term exhaustion.
- **Early Rebounds:** Housing-linked names are improving in rank despite low underlying momentum scores, including Building Materials (+5 spots, 0.33 momentum), Residential Construction (+5 spots, 0.29 momentum), and Lumber & Wood Production (+5 spots, 0.47 momentum).
